title: Austin's Energy & Infrastructure Vision
summary:
*   A major May 5th bond election was previewed, alongside updates on neighborhood planning, housing agreements, and proposals for new airport parking.
*   Significant discussions regarding the deregulation of the electric utility industry were postponed, highlighting a critical, ongoing policy debate for Austin Energy.
*   Key contracts were approved for vital public services like wastewater toxicity testing, and the city greenlit an energy conservation rebate, supporting efficiency upgrades for businesses.
